name: onecell-hooks
description: Optional hooks for onecell in Claude Code: relevant memory on your prompts, a nudge to save what a turn settled, and a short briefing at the start of a session. Each is off until you turn it on at onecell.io/settings/agents.

api_key.title: onecell API key
api_key.description: An ic_ key from onecell.io/settings/agents#keys. Create it with Drafts only ticked: the hooks only read and keep session state. Stored in your system's credential store.
